basis: PR407/d0b21a4 measurement harness; perf/direct-solid-packing implementation on main bb53387
method: 7 fresh scene identities per size and input provenance, fixed mutable then owned, 0/100/1000 extra walls+windows. Owned snapshot creation excluded as prior commit/load; mutable input checks included in each public preparation. Scene setup once, then four new gestures: A/A/B/A with distinct deltas, same immutable display base and retained GPU-buffer plan. B is two rest walls (baseline: OG pair); B has two hosted windows versus A one. Independent pack probes run afterward and are not additive initial-buffer phases. 168 full wall/window comparisons and 42 exact packed-buffer comparisons outside timing. Node CPU only, no React/snapping/GPU/frame/native measurement; process-cold/JIT/GC effects uncontrolled. Raw samples retained; no percentile claim from seven trials.
runNote: Final serial runs after tests/build finished; earlier overlapping runs discarded. Same harness as PR407; Node CPU only.
